PHASE D: A RATIONAL ROTATION FAMILY AND AN EXACT UNIFORM RANK OBSTRUCTION

Status. No PPT channel with a non-EB cube is obtained. The seven preregistered
samples have no negative Breuer-Hall witness. More substantially, a fixed exact
Kraus-span certificate proves full Choi rank for EVERY rotation in the selected
continuous family. Thus the source's product-free range mechanism cannot be
extended along this family. Full rank does not imply separability. Separability
of the six nonzero samples, and the general PPT cube question, remain UNKNOWN.

This is separate from Phase B PROOFS.txt; the completed proofs are unchanged.
Read-only authorized Phase C premises: ppt_cube_chain_sol/PROOF.txt, its frozen
cube_separable_certificate.json and verify_cube_stdlib.py, plus the independent
ppt_cube_blind_review/cross_audit.txt. No new Phase D alignment report was read.
The original certificate hash is
256745ff4887eadb653a8fdb416ccb15e91051756065396eb58d11761173d961.
Its exact stdlib verification is rerun by each Phase D replay. The original
source square non-EB theorem is not needed for any conclusion below.

1. Physical channels and exact reduction

Use the original notation S:M10->M6, C=Ad_K with K=K*=K^-1, B=S* C,
F=Ad_E S:M10->M10, G=B Ad_E*:M10->M10. E embeds the first six coordinates.
Theta is the source trace-completed two-cycle H0=C10 -> H1=C10 -> H0,
with absorbing scalar flag. Both active coefficients are c=1/1485980.

For any unitary U on C21, Phi_U=Theta Ad_U is exactly CP, TP and co-CP:
Ad_U is a TP CP channel; T Theta is CP; (T Theta) Ad_U is CP. This conclusion
requires no numerical eigenvalues. Source trace completion is retained exactly.

Let U=diag(U0,I10,1). Rightmost input conjugation does not change EB status:
  Phi_U^3 = [Theta Ad_U Theta Ad_U Theta] Ad_U.
The only nonflag quantum corners of the bracketed channel are
  H0 -> H1: c^3 Ad_E S Ad_U0 B S,
  H1 -> H0: c^3 B S Ad_U0 B Ad_E*.
All other paths contain a rank-one-output flag branch and are EB. Local input
and output compressions isolate both displayed corners. Therefore
  Phi_U^3 EB iff S Ad_U0 B S and B S Ad_U0 B are both EB.
No branch is postselected to manufacture a nonlinear channel: the full physical
channel is TP, and local Choi compression is used only as a separability test.

2. Classes that collapse before a search

(a) U0 is scalar, and U1 on H1 preserves the active first-six subspac
